scope: Educational organ-specific Body Exposure knowledge seed. This record supports general ovarian anatomy/physiology relationships only; it does not establish patient-specific anatomy, fertility status, ovarian reserve, diagnosis, prognosis, treatment, dose, procedural targeting, clinical efficacy, academic validation, or human review.

relationships.claim: Ovarian follicles progress through regulated developmental stages involving communication between the oocyte and surrounding somatic cells; antral follicle development becomes dependent on pituitary gonadotropins.
FSH and LH participate in regulation of antral follicle development, while local intraovarian signaling also contributes to follicular growth and maturation.
During a typical ovulatory cycle, a dominant follicle may reach the preovulatory stage and ovulate; remaining follicular somatic cells then differentiate to form the corpus luteum.
